text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That makes ten in a row, huh. Such 
peerless precision and control... She 
wasn't called a prodigy for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To hit the exact same spot with such 
precision... Are they doing some special 
training to hone their focus?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, that can't be. As if you could fool my 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Achieving that level of precision should 
be impossible without extreme mental 
focus. ...What say you?

text_block_list.text: ...It has nothing to do with you.

easily. Very well... I'll expose it 
myself.

can, that is.
